high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "bloombergbusiness." The post features a background image of a cloudy sky with sunlight filtering through, creating a warm and uplifting atmosphere. The content of the post discusses various incentives offered by different entities to encourage more people to get vaccinated against COVID-19. Specifically: Qantas Airways: The post mentions that Qantas Airways is offering unlimited flights for a year as part of a promotion to encourage vaccination.
